Package gui

Class Terminal_GUI

java.lang.Object
gui.Terminal_GUI
public class Terminal_GUI extends Object
Controller class for the Terminal GUI. This class manages the terminal interface for user interactions such as check-in, instant booking, bill payment, and reservation cancellation.
